signal: Onspring launched Onspring AI, an embedded GRC AI suite powered by Anthropic's Claude models

email.body1:
Beth, saw Onspring just launched Onspring AI, your embedded GRC suite built on Claude.

Shipping AI into the platform usually lights up more in-market accounts than the team can cover before the interest cools, and that is where pipeline leaks. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Onspring off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Beth, quick follow-up for Onspring.

As a CRO, you carry the number, but most teams don't actually know how many meetings it takes to hit it, so the coverage gap shows up late and recovery eats the quarter. Reps stuck in research and CRM instead of selling only stretches it wider.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Onspring needs to hit target this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Beth, last bit of proof for Onspring.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Onspring's reply rate likely compares to other growth-stage GRC teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Beth, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Launching new AI capabilities is its own kind of busy, and I know timing is everything.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a GRC sales motion? I'll tailor it to Onspring either way.
